edges.reason: migrate requires msg.sender to equal factory.
setImplementation requires msg.sender to equal factory.
upgrade requires msg.sender to equal borrower.
acceptBorrower requires msg.sender to equal pendingBorrower.
closeLoan uses msg.sender to gate transferFrom and drawable funds usage.
drawdownFunds requires msg.sender to equal borrower.
makePayment uses msg.sender to gate transferFrom and drawable funds usage.
postCollateral uses msg.sender as transferFrom source.
proposeNewTerms requires msg.sender to equal borrower.
removeCollateral requires msg.sender to equal borrower.
returnFunds uses msg.sender as transferFrom source.
setPendingBorrower requires msg.sender to equal borrower.
acceptLender requires msg.sender to equal pendingLender.
acceptNewTerms requires msg.sender to equal lender.
claimFunds requires msg.sender to equal lender.
fundLoan uses msg.sender as transferFrom source.
repossess requires msg.sender to equal lender.
setPendingLender requires msg.sender to equal lender.
skim requires msg.sender to be borrower or lender.
closeLoan checks block.timestamp for late payment status.
repossess checks default via block.timestamp and grace period.
_closeLoan uses block.timestamp for late payment check.
_makePayment indirectly depends on block.timestamp through payment breakdown.
refinancer_ is used by acceptNewTerms refinance flow.
calls_ is iterated in acceptNewTerms delegatecall loop.
amount_ controls optional transferFrom in closeLoan.
destination_ receives drawn funds in drawdownFunds.
arguments_ is passed to migrator delegatecall.
lender_ is registered as lender in fundLoan.
drawdown_ is input for additional collateral calculation.
acceptNewTerms calls ERC20Helper.transfer for extra funds.
fundLoan calls ERC20Helper.transfer for extra funds.
_getCollateralRequiredFor multiplies and subtracts with checked arithmetic.
_scaledExponent performs repeated multiplication with checked arithmetic.
delegatecall to migrator can reenter migrate.
delegatecall to refinancer can reenter acceptNewTerms.
external token call may reenter closeLoan.
external token call may reenter makePayment.
external token call may reenter postCollateral.
external token call may reenter returnFunds.
external token call may reenter claimFunds.
external token call may reenter fundLoan.
external token call may reenter repossess.
external token call may reenter skim.
factory upgradeInstance external call may reenter upgrade.
globals external call may reenter fundLoan.
